scope: All locked releases; selected direct getter definitions and return types, deduplicated by whitespace-normalized method text. Null means not defined in the scanned implementation file, not unsupported API. Return expressions are lexical excerpts, not a substitute for control flow; transitive helpers, metadata, share-limit configuration and runtime libtorrent behavior are not fully reviewed.
findings: Size getters are unchanged: wanted bytes, completed wanted bytes and full metadata size are distinct; never recalculate progress from these values while checking. 4.1.1 first uses native checking progress and double-precision ordinary progress; 4.5.3 logs out-of-range progress rather than asserting.

All-time downloaded/uploaded, session payload totals, piece counts and wasted bytes (failed plus redundant) retain their getter expressions. Transfer speeds are payload bytes/sec; 4.5.0 starts suppressing paused rates, renamed stopped in 5.0.0. Use the server values without locally zeroing older paused rates.

4.2.0 introduces libtorrent <1.2 versus >=1.2 time getter branches and widens active/finished/seeding time to signed 64-bit seconds. 4.3.0 drops old time branches; 4.5.0 removes seedingTime getter and serializer uses finishedTime. Elapsed time is not ETA; 8640000 seconds is the ETA cap, not a cap on elapsed time or reannounce.
4.5.0 accepts tracker-reported zero swarm counts instead of falling back to peer list estimates. Queue conversion moved to serializer at 4.3.4; wire positions remain one-based/zero unqueued.

4.1.0 and 5.3.1 properties controllers normalize nonpositive rate limits to -1. General pane must distinguish this from negative transfer speed and missing values. Ratio sentinel handling still needs historical cap review; no new inference from 9999.
4.3.1 moves remaining-size subtraction into the common interface helper. Exact helper verified at 4.3.1; transitive helper history still pending.
